title: nan
authors: Schindler D.; Niculescu V.; Polonelli T.; Palossi D.; Benini L.; Magno M.
key_contribution: Presents a relative infrastructure-less localization algorithm for decentralized UAV swarms without reliable heading angles in indoor/GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
